issues.explanation: In the 20–30% score bucket on the test months, actual churn was 32.6%, not 23.6% (transposed digits). Showing 23.6% also makes actual churn appear below the 24.6% average prediction, contradicting seg2 narration ('about 33 percent left... runs low on both sides of 30') and seg4 visual ('32.6%').
issues.evidence: facts.json -> calibration.logreg[3]: bin='20-30%', n=291, predicted=0.246, actual=0.326
issues.fix: Change '23.6%' to '32.6%' in the 20–30% row of seg2 visual.

issues.explanation: In the 50–70% score bucket for logistic regression on the test months, the average predicted churn ('Model said') was 57.6%, not 50.6%.
issues.evidence: facts.json -> calibration.logreg[6]: bin='50-70%', n=98, predicted=0.576, actual=0.663
issues.fix: Change '50.6%' to '57.6%' in the 50–70% row of seg4 visual.

issues.quote: Then it was tested on May and June, when about 93 percent churned.
issues.explanation: Actual churn in the May–June test months was about 13 percent (13.2%), not 93 percent. Saying 93 percent also directly contradicts seg5 visual ('10.9% → 13.2%') and the rest of the lesson.
issues.fix: Change 'when about 93 percent churned' to 'when about 13 percent churned'.

verdict: Conceptually sound and well-aligned with the brief, with strong quiz and review items, but contains three high-severity numeric typos that must be fixed before publication: '23.6%' instead of '32.6%' in seg2 visual, '50.6%' instead of '57.6%' in seg4 visual, and 'about 93 percent churned' instead of 'about 13 percent churned' in seg5 narration.
